Recently I've seen many user posts asking about broken thumbnails on Voat. So today I decided to see if I could find the issue. Here we go:

Interestingly, the thumbnail issue does not occur for posts linking directly to image files, and seems to occur intermittently - especially with YouTube links.

So, the class in question is ThumbGenerator.cs within Voat.Business. Specifically, we're looking at the ThumbnailFromSubmission() method which is called for all new linkposts arriving to the HomeController.

Initially it seemed that the issue could be with the OpenGraph.ParseUri() method, which usually takes a 3rd Boolean parameter, and with the subsequent if (graph.Image = null) return null statement. After some testing, it was clear that the issue lied elsewhere.

It seemed that there was an exception being thrown & caught, thus causing the ThumbnailFromSubmission() to return null. By setting breakpoints and disabling the try/catch I was able to find and view the exception details, which are: [WebException: The operation has timed out] (...) Voat.Utilities.<generateThumbFromUrl>

Surely enough, within the generateThumbFromUrl() method the request.Timeout is set to 300 milliseconds. This means that if the request is not answered (with an image) within 300 milliseconds, then the method will throw an exception. By increasing the request.Timeout value to 1000 milliseconds this resolved the issue: thumbnails are now consistently created for YouTube links.

Of course, this is just me testing locally. @Atko and @PuttItOut may like to look this over and adjust that request.Timeout value. This should fix the thumbnail issue on Voat.
